main.description: Moves messages into another thread or channel. A message lives in its author's own repo and cannot be rewritten by a moderator, so the move is a `moved` label written into the source space for each message. The destination serves each moved message at its own record key, so a selection keeps the order it was written in and reads among the destination's own messages by send time. The AppView withholds a moved message from the space it came from.

source.description: The space the messages are in now, either a channel or a thread.

destination.description: The space to move them to, either a channel or a thread in the same community.

subjects.description: The messages to move, at most fifty in one call.

reason.description: Human-readable reason, recorded on every label in the batch.

batch.description: The batch key shared by every label this call wrote, which groups the move for auditing.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the thread.move permission, or may not read the source or post in the destination.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space exists at the source or destination reference.

errors.name: MessageNotFound
errors.description: One of the subjects is not a message in the source space.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The destination is the source, belongs to another community, or a subject is not a message.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
